I will farm this rice plot almost the same way I did before, only with a little fertilizer because rice without it does not give me enough grain. I trust what I have seen on other people’s fields here, so I will use the better seed if I can get it, but I will not spend money on irrigation because this plot depends on the rains. I will use some manure from home and one herbicide spray so the weeding does not eat all my time, then I will still use family work and hire a few hands when the work is heavy.
